name: Witch
ability: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
wakes: Every night while more than 3 players live.
interaction: Chooses any player (alive or dead, self allowed); is told nothing.
drunk_or_poisoned: The curse does nothing: the cursed player survives if they nominate. Being drunk or poisoned at the time of the nomination also prevents the death.

rulings.text: The cursed player dies when they nominate, but the nomination still counts.
The curse lasts one day; the same player may be cursed again.
When only 3 players live, the curse ends and the Witch stops acting.
The curse stays with the player even if their character changes.
The Witch may curse a dead player, or themself (if they then nominate, they die).

test_scenarios.name: cursed nominator dies
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Witch, Bob Sage, Carol Chef, Dave Imp, Eve Monk, Fay Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice curses Bob. Day 1: Bob nominates Carol.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob dies immediately; the nomination of Carol continues and Carol can be executed.

test_scenarios.name: curse expires
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: curse Bob. Night 2: curse Carol. Day 2: Bob nominates.

test_scenarios.name: three alive
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Witch, Bob Savant, Dave Imp, Eve Monk; Bob cursed.
test_scenarios.actions: Same night: Dave kills Eve, leaving 3 alive. Day: Bob nominates.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob survives; the Witch has lost the ability.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned witch
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Witch poisoned by Erin Poisoner; Bob Chef cursed.

test_scenarios.name: non-nominator safe
test_scenarios.actions: Day: Bob does not nominate but is nominated and executed.
test_scenarios.expected: Curse causes no death; Bob dies only to execution.
